strings.name: Bruce Springsteen
strings.summary: Raised in New Jersey, Springsteen writes about work, community, mobility and contradictions in American life, often with the E Street Band. Born to Run brought his 1975 breakthrough and Born in the U.S.A. expanded his international reach in 1984. Acoustic records such as Nebraska and marathon concerts show another side of his career. He continues recording, performing and public advocacy, touring the US with the band in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His rock songs about labor, community and changes in American society, together with live performances, have influenced public culture across generations.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Long Branch, New Jersey, United States; raised in Freehold.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education and beginnings
strings.facts.f2.value: Learned guitar and played in local bands as a teenager, developing through New Jersey club performances.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Narratives of work and American society
strings.highlights.h1.text: Born to Run, Nebraska and Born in the U.S.A. explore aspiration, hardship and social change.
strings.highlights.h2.title: An enduring live tradition
strings.highlights.h2.text: Collective work with the E Street Band and extended concerts have influenced generations of rock listeners.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Began US tour
strings.timeline.t1.text: Launched the Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour with the E Street Band, continuing musical public expression.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Released Tracks II
strings.timeline.t2.text: The Lost Albums collected seven previously unreleased studio albums, opening a long creative archive.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Sold catalog rights
strings.timeline.t3.text: Sold recording and publishing catalog rights to Sony in a major music-rights transaction.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Opened Broadway show
strings.timeline.t4.text: Springsteen on Broadway combined autobiography and songs, later receiving a special Tony Award.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Released The Rising
strings.timeline.t5.text: Worked with the E Street Band on loss, solidarity and rebuilding after September 11.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Entered Rock and Roll Hall of Fame
strings.timeline.t6.text: Received Hall of Fame recognition while reuniting the E Street Band for touring.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Released Born in the U.S.A.
strings.timeline.t7.text: The album expanded his commercial and international reach, with narratives often subject to political interpretation.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Broke through with Born to Run
strings.timeline.t8.text: His third album moved him from regional performer to national and international recognition.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Released debut album
strings.timeline.t9.text: Released Greetings from Asbury Park, N.J., followed by a second album that year.
